title: Jeralt Private Warning
prompt:
In the dim teacher office or library, Jeralt closes the door or stands near it, then warns Byleth with fatherly concern and political suspicion. Byleth listens silently. Candlelight flickers across books and armor.

Camera: static tense composition with a small push toward Jeralt.
negative_prompt: No game UI, no subtitles, no readable text, no watermark, no modern objects. No identity drift, face swaps, costume drift, extra limbs, warped hands, flickering faces, or sudden style changes. Avoid: shouting, melodrama, readable book text. No middle-aged face unless canonically required, no old face, no wrinkles, no tired eye bags, no harsh pores, no weathered skin, no gaunt face, no matronly look, no gritty realism, no generic medieval extra. Keep academy students youthful, attractive, clean-skinned and official-game-inspired; for war phase students, keep them early-20s and beautiful, showing war pressure through costume, posture, lighting and setting, not through aging.
